purpose: Teach: 容積/相乗/喝采/セレクション/省エネルギー/真っ最中/ダントツ/授賞

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、倉庫の容積効率を高めろ
lines.en: Increase the cubic efficiency of our warehouse.
lines.style: Sharp, decisive. Clipped delivery on the core demand. No softening—this is an instruction, not a request. Steady eye contact, posture erect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業間の相乗効果を狙います
lines.en: Yes. We'll pursue synergies across divisions.
lines.style: Measured and professional. Slight nod on the acknowledgment. Even pace, calm precision. Shows he's already thinking through the logistics.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の喝采を浴びる商品を出せ
lines.en: I want our company to release a product that earns staff approval.
lines.style: Direct and authoritative. Weight on 'approval'—this isn't about sales alone. Steady delivery, no inflection beyond clarity. Expects understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新メンバーのセレクションを進めます
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with new talent selection.
lines.style: Composed confirmation. Slightly faster than the previous line—efficiency in the cadence. Professional assurance without overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 省エネルギー機器を導入しろ
lines.style: Terse, practical command. Minimal words, maximum clarity. No preamble. The tone of someone who expects execution, not debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。決算の真っ最中ですが対応します
lines.en: Yes. We're in the middle of our fiscal close, but we'll handle it.
lines.style: Steady and reliable. Acknowledges the pressure without making excuses. Calm determination underneath. Shows he won't let obstacles become reasons.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界ダントツの売上を狙え
lines.en: I want our company to dominate the industry in sales figures.
lines.style: Firm and aspirational. Clear emphasis on 'dominate'—this is the goal. Controlled energy, not shouty. The voice of someone painting the vision they expect to see realized.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。授賞式の準備を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll have everything ready for the awards ceremony.
lines.style: Professional closure. Confident and clean. Slight lift at the end—this is a commitment he's making. Meets the moment with quiet assurance.
